title: StreamingMemoryEvent v1
description: Dual-timeline streaming memory event (KGR-G-014). Records agent memory with both event_time (when the fact occurred) and ingestion_time (when it was recorded), plus salience decay metadata.

memory_id.description: Unique identifier for this memory event.

agent_id.description: Agent that produced or consumed this memory.

event_time.description: When the underlying fact or observation occurred in the real world.

ingestion_time.description: When this memory was ingested into the streaming memory store.

content_type.description: Semantic category of the memory content.

text.description: Natural language content of the memory.

embedding_vector.description: Pre-computed embedding for vector similarity retrieval.

current_score.description: Current decayed salience. Computed at query time.

half_life_seconds.description: Time for salience to halve (exponential decay).

access_count.description: Number of times this memory was retrieved (boosts salience).

pinned.description: If true, salience never decays below a minimum threshold.

provenance_refs.description: Evidence chain linking to source facts.

supersedes.description: Memory ID that this event corrects or supersedes (conflict resolution).
